verdicts.reason: A leads with a huge, empty starfield panel that takes the top half. The product can is shrunk to an unreadable icon under the CTA, and the orange glow circle has come loose and overlaps the Shop Now button, so the hero product is effectively gone. B has a sensible reading order (logo, headline, copy, image, CTA) with well-placed headline type, but it repeats the same fatal flaws: the starfield panel sits empty without its can, the circle collides with the CTA, and the can is a tiny fragment stranded in the bottom-left corner.
